› Call request_user_input once to ask me one question: "Which colour?" with options red and blue. After I answer, write the colour I chose to colour.txt and stop.









































































































  Question 1/1 (1 unanswered)
  Which colour?

  › 1. red                Choose red.
    2. blue               Choose blue.
    3. None of the above  Optionally, add details in notes (tab)

  tab to add notes | enter to submit answer | esc to interrupt
